thread:
mina: Quick postmortem follow-up — consolidated remediation items for streaming/chat reliability. Main buckets: reconnect logic, partial/truncated detection, timeouts + tests, and dashboards. Claim one + ETA please.

oscar: I'll take reconnect logic. Plan: add per-session resume lock, cap resume attempts to 3, add exponential backoff with jitter, and a per-customer circuit-breaker when resume_fail_rate high. ETA 2026-02-05. Will open PR today.

zara: I'll own partial/truncated detection and alerting. Emit `stream.truncated`/`stream.partial` events with request_id + model tag, add trace span for retry attempts, and wire PagerDuty if rate > 0.03% over 5m. ETA 2026-02-09. Ticket REM-2026-158.

mina: infra owner for dashboards? Need panels for incomplete_streams, resume_fail_rate, proxy_503_tail and a weekly watch alert.

infra-bot: Creating Grafana folder `streams/reliability` and scaffolding panels. Proposed alerts: incomplete_streams > 0.035% (5m), resume_fail_rate > 0.3% (5m).

oscar: sample log pattern that motivated the change:
```
2026-02-10T09:14:21Z req=0x2c7a stream=221 status=partial tokens=164 err=EOF
2026-02-10T09:14:21Z req=0x2c7a reconnect=1 route=gpu-pool-1 latency_ms=4980
2026-02-10T09:14:23Z req=0x2c7a final=client_deadline
```
This repeats on high load.
